title: Size and correctness of the chosen Boolean table
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number and let $p$ be a Boolean predicate on $\ell$-bit vectors. The chosen CNF table for $p$ uses at most $\ell$ variables, has at most $2^\ell$ clauses, and every clause has at most $\ell$ literals; under every Boolean assignment to the natural numbers, it evaluates to $p$ applied to the assignment's first $\ell$ bits.
replaced: For every arity $\ell$ and predicate $p$ on $\ell$-bit vectors, the chosen CNF table uses at most $\ell$ variables, has at most $2^\ell$ clauses, has width at most $\ell$, and evaluates under any assignment $a$ to exactly $p$ applied to the first $\ell$ bits of $a$.
